extraction_quality_notes: Ranking observations were limited to case-presentation symptoms, diabetes context, initial blood glucose and blood pressure, ECG interpretation, elevated cardiac biomarkers, oxygenation with oxygen-flow context, echocardiography, and pre-revascularization coronary angiography.

No expected-manifold label, final diagnosis field, paper-title-derived diagnostic evidence, abstract-derived evidence, treatment response, or discussion causal framing is included as ranking evidence.
Ordinary observation axes are diagnosis-neutral and do not use disease-specific *_in_D-* suffixes.
The case text reports ECG interpretation but not exact ST-segment lead measurements; a neutral anterior-wall acute ischemic ECG-pattern axis was used with a quality note.
Troponin T and NT-proBNP are described only as elevated; no numeric biomarker values or reference ranges are provided.
Oxygen saturation was measured after oxygen was given; the 6 L/min oxygen-flow context is retained because room-air saturation is not reported.
Heart rate, respiratory rate, body temperature, lactate, pH, creatinine, complete blood count, electrolytes, CRP, and detailed physical examination findings are not reported in the case body.
